create_CocoEvaluator: create a CocoEvaluator instance with a COCO ground truth dataset and a list of IoU types
update_CocoEvaluator_predictions: update the CocoEvaluator with new model predictions to accumulate per-image evaluation results
prepare_for_coco_detection: prepare model predictions into COCO detection format with bounding boxes, scores, and category labels
prepare_for_coco_segmentation: prepare model predictions into COCO segmentation format with RLE-encoded masks, scores, and labels
convert_to_xywh: convert bounding boxes from xyxy format to xywh format using a PyTorch tensor transformation
